'''Kæhaxa''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sakiya]]. Like the cities of [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]], Kæhaxa used [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] technology to hover above the ground. This allowed to city to slowly move across the planet, and it often stopped near small villages.<ref name="LoNH" />
